title: tessera.audit-plan/1
description: What `tessera audit plan` and `tessera-verify audit plan` report (RFC-0016 'Calculators', tessera_protocol::AuditPlan, tv_core::audit_plan::AuditPlan): per bucket of the policy and in total, the detection probability of the violating requests against a prover that pads them into a later bucket, the same if none leaves its bucket, the amortized overhead and the rates that reach a target overhead. The verifier computes detection from the policy and the traffic alone; without a cost model (`--mu`) the figures that need `μ` are null. Binary64 planning figures: none enters a sample or an artifact.

source_defaults.description: Whether `μ` comes from the source's counts and unit costs rather than an execution plan's counts; null in the verifier's plan without a cost model.

eta.description: `η`, the ratio of ideal prefill time to serving time per token; the verifier's is its cost model's scenario's, null without one.

target_overhead.description: `O`, the amortized overhead the target rates are set for; the verifier's is its cost model's scenario's, null without one.

detection.description: `1 − Π_b (1 − s̲_b)^{v_b}`: at least one violating request selected, each padded into the later bucket of lowest rate.

detection_in_place.description: `1 − Π_b (1 − s_b)^{v_b}`: the same if no violating request leaves its bucket, an upper bound.

overhead.description: `Σ_b n_b·L_b·s_b·μ_b·η / Σ_b n_b·L_b`, the amortized overhead; null without a cost model.

expected_selected.description: `Σ_b n_b·s_b`, the requests a sample is expected to select.

mu.description: The cost model's `μ_b` at the bucket's mean length; null without a cost model.

target_rate.description: `min(1, O/(μ_b·η))`, the rate that alone gives the target overhead at the bucket's context; null without a cost model.
